items.text: Looking for final expense coverage? There are options, including policies with no health questions. Those usually have a waiting period before the full benefit is paid, so it helps to know how that works before you choose. Policies that do ask a few health questions may pay the full amount sooner. We can explain the difference. Licensed in VA, MD, GA, TX, MI, NC, SC, AL, LA, IN and WV. Call (571) 354-0146 or visit honorbrook-insurance.com.
